subject: Example Mechanical Services
body:
Mr Example, my name is J. Buyer. I run Harbour Ridge, and we buy and hold commercial mechanical service businesses in the Midwest. We do not broker and we are not a fund with a clock on it.

You said in a trade piece this year that service contracts are now half the business and that there is no next generation in the trade. That is the situation I would want to talk about, not the numbers.

Would you be open to a short call in the next few weeks, at a time that suits you? If the timing is wrong, no reply needed and I will not keep writing.

J. Buyer
Harbour Ridge
[postal address]
